title: Charles V -> Lope de Soria, ambassador at Genoa, 23 Aug 1523: duplicate of no. 18; the cipher part untranslated
correspondents: Charles V -> Lope de Soria, ambassador at Genoa
shelfmark: Archive of Lope de Soria, offered to the Real Academia de la Historia 1931 (present location to confirm), item 19 of the 1931 catalogue
folio_note: Catalogue of the archive of Lope de Soria offered to the Real Academia de la Historia in 1931 (Boletin de la Real Academia de la Historia 98, 1931, pp. 363ff), no. 19: duplicate of no. 18; the cipher part untranslated
status: The 1931 catalogue states the cipher part is not translated/deciphered. This is the incoming correspondence of Lope de Soria; his outgoing letters to Charles V are RAH Salazar A-28 (DECODE R9488-R9498) and are already worked in this repo (targets/soria1527, 1523 key A/B).
why: Charles V's and Ferdinand's own cipher to their ambassador at Genoa and Venice; the repo already holds Soria's 1523-27 keys for the other direction.
